== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-4lomsconcussionrifle-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[4-LOM's Concussion Rifle (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 12 March 2016): Same words. As a slip it again has the black strip with a white italic “E”, but no title in the strip, and the bronze disc is gone.

The same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
